text: ニンジャは　むかし　から　よく　どうぶつを　つかった　という

structure.jp: むかし　から　よく　どうぶつを　つかった
structure.en: often used animals since long ago

patterns.name: 〜という (hearsay)
patterns.explanation: という at the end of a sentence means 'they say' or 'it is said': the speaker is passing on what is told. つかった　という = 'it's said they used them'.
